lines: Outreach Internship Programme (OIP) is one of the research initiatives of IIIT Naya Raipur, to bring
students from prominent institutions across the country right here to our campus. The institute has
been organizing this programme since 2017. Many students who participated in the previous
programme have benefited from this programme, which is evident through the papers published by
them in journals and conferences of repute. With this motivation, this year also, IIIT-NR invites
students from all over India to spend 6 to 8 weeks in the institute, carrying out research under the
supervision of IIIT-NR faculty members and making use of state-of-art laboratory facilities at IIIT-NR.
The OIP programme allows students to participate in ongoing research projects and simultaneously
enables them to fulfill the summer internship requirements of their respective academic programs.
Selected interns will get the chance to work diligently with motivated researchers to:
1. Innovate technical solutions for core research areas.
2. Create and deliver a pioneering solution for real-life problems.
3. Publish their work in reputed conferences and journals.
